description: Component map of the agent harness and its control plane for the master test plan. Source and test globs are repo-relative; ** matches any depth. Edit here, then run scripts/harness_test_inventory.py.

components.name: Control-plane catalog
components.responsibilities: One catalog of items across kinds (toolsets, MCP servers, skills, engines, plugins) with provenance, version, risk class and one digest scheme

components.name: Policy engine (dimensions, precedence, narrowing)
components.status: built (CPD-3: one generic resolver over policy-dimensions.json in Node and Python)
components.responsibilities: Typed policy dimensions as ceilings or choices; meet across deployment, org, team, agent, user and request layers; refusal names the first widening

components.name: Control-plane stores and write transaction
components.status: partial (PolicyStore built, CPD-4: Mongo store, KV read-through, migration, Config* over the store in dual; installations, grants, bindings, approvals are CPD-7..9)
components.responsibilities: Installations, grants, policy layers, bindings and approval requests with revision CAS, history, per-org isolation; one transaction that writes and audits

components.name: Run-config resolver and pinner
components.status: built (CPD-5: RunConfigPinner; CPD-6: llm, deployment layer, Labs stages, the worker reads the pin)
components.responsibilities: Resolve the effective set and effective run config for a subject once, pin it on the run with a digest; every admission path uses it; wake never re-resolves

components.name: Audit chain and config audit
components.status: built (journal audit chain; config.changed by CPD-1, proven per admin route on Mongo by QA-4)
components.responsibilities: Per-org hash-chained audit of journal events, gateway refusals and every control-plane write in the same transaction; anchoring; verifier; downloads and transcript reads chained. Extension points: where anchors are written (HarnessEdition.auditAnchors), background workers and org erasure steps (HarnessEdition.workers, orgErasers)

components.name: Change notifier and live layer
components.status: built (CPD-6: outbox and broker notifier in Node, live layer cache and narrowed approvals in Python)
components.responsibilities: Publish config change events after commit; per-org ordered invalidation; worker and gateway live layer that can only narrow, with a 30 s TTL backstop

components.name: Admin API, authorizer and explain
components.status: partial (per-domain admin routes built; /api/v1/control-plane is CPD-11)
components.responsibilities: Admin and builder routes for policy, engine profile, model access, memory policy, retention; router guards; preview and per-run explain; routes an edition adds to the control-plane table (`HarnessEdition.controlPlaneRoutes`, none in this build)

components.name: Chat routes and routing
components.status: built (one-request routing is LAT1/CPD-10, in flight)
components.responsibilities: Existing chat routes (stream, agent stream, regenerate, Slack /internal twins, MCP header) decide durable or legacy server-side, project and agent scope; first frame conversation_created

components.name: Admission
components.responsibilities: Decide and admit a run atomically: rollout, agent access, engine profile, model access, worker features, roles, labels, memory pin, quotas, idempotency; one active root run per session

components.name: Journal, execution store, outbox and sweepers
components.responsibilities: Fenced, sealed, gap-free event journal; run state machine (claim, renew, commit, control); payload claim-checks; dispatch outbox and relay; run sweeper, holdoff and degraded modes; data keys

components.name: Projection, live bus and streaming
components.responsibilities: Project journal + LiveBus deltas into AG-UI SSE frames, transcripts and timelines; reconnect with Last-Event-ID; per-viewer audiences; terminal frames authored by Node

components.name: Worker, claimer and loop kernel
components.responsibilities: Claim runs (inline and polled), fold the journal, drive the loop (Agent.step, durable driver), commit by the commit rules, dispatch tools, suspend and resume, cancel, steering, crash recovery

components.name: Child runs and deep mode
components.responsibilities: Spawn child runs under a narrowed grant (tools, budget share, workspace fork), join, lift child approvals to the parent thread, deep-mode phase machine and waves

components.name: Context compiler
components.responsibilities: Compile each request from the journal in fixed cache bands; reduction ladder (clear > 50%, compact > 80%); notes; flag-off byte equality

components.name: Model gateway and transports
components.responsibilities: Native transports (OpenAI chat and Responses, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Azure, Ollama) with usage, retries and output limits; model policy and fallback; provider state; the model gateway serving engines (chat, Responses, Messages wires) with run tokens and budget

components.name: Tool gateway, effects and invoker
components.responsibilities: Run tool endpoint for engines (MCP transport), effect runner with intent/outcome, effect classes and recovery, invoker and tool catalog, time and stall bounds, sink tags

components.name: Knowledge read gate and publications
components.responsibilities: Every knowledge read (search, fetch, lookup_record, raw content) goes through the record-access gate; publications widen to an audience (answer_only or full); no existence oracle

components.name: MCP hub and runners
components.responsibilities: Schema cache, pooled sessions per (org, instance, credential owner), manifest approval, tool-name rules, SSRF guard; STDIO servers in per-owner runner sandboxes

components.name: Toolsets and credentials
components.responsibilities: Toolset instances and instance-scoped tool identity; credential service and vault (versioned, sealed), leases bound to run; token refresh; no secret in prompt, journal, logs or sandbox

components.name: Skills
components.status: built (creator scoping by CPS, merged at a168c7d5c)
components.responsibilities: Skill catalog, bundles and digests, pinned skills per run, materialiser into sandboxes, skill packs for engines, visibility per creator

components.name: Governed memory
components.responsibilities: Memories per actor (and agent), labelled and access-checked; proposals and review; settlement after commit (durable via sweeper); rendering band

components.name: Approvals, interactions, flow guard and unknown effects
components.responsibilities: Approval policy (org layers, engine writes), interactions (consume once, expiry, re-authorization), flow rule after private reads, conversation grants, unknown effects answered by the run's actor, reconcile hooks, run gates (dry run, plan approval, verify; G-03..G-05); the approvals and questions waiting on a person (the Inbox's sources). Who besides the actor approves (`ApproverDirectory`), whose runs the waiting approvals are read from (`ApprovalQueueReach`) and waiting-run notices (`WaitingRunNotices`, `ApproverNoticeOutbox`) are extension points (built-in: the run's actor approves, admins deny, nobody is named, the viewer's own runs, no notices)

components.name: Budget ledger
components.responsibilities: Accounts and reservations per run tree; reserve at the output limit, settle on usage; child shares; refusal codes; metered compaction, cost ledger and the usage report (C9.06, C11.07); ADR-RUN-01 D4: the run budget tree (one RunBudget, a child's slice, the phase plan, person waits pausing the clock, the tool time bound)

components.name: Sandbox broker and run_code
components.responsibilities: Broker that alone holds the Docker socket: create, exec, put/get, limits, destroy, reap, isolation classes, per-sandbox networks; run_code on legacy and durable paths with receipts

components.name: Egress proxy
components.responsibilities: The only way out of a sandbox: token routes to gateways, allowlisted hosts, CONNECT tunnels (flag), SSRF and blocked CIDRs, control plane bound off sandbox networks, durable sealed state, refusal audit
interfaces: egress proxy data and control ports

components.name: Workspace store, snapshots and warm pool
components.status: built (warm pool and snapshots off by default)
components.responsibilities: CAS workspace revisions, forks and merges, one writer per workspace, sealing, sync into and out of sandboxes, encrypted engine snapshots, warm pool sizing

components.name: Engines and engine controller
components.status: built (opencode, Codex and Claude Code released; ACP driver with opencode's ACP server, Gemini CLI, Goose, Qwen Code and DeepSeek Harness (WP-105), each usable where its image is installed, profiles unsigned until OB-1)
components.responsibilities: Engine adapters (launch, map events, state), controller lifecycle (turns, ticker, autosave, writer lease), durable engine kernel, engine profiles and ceilings, release allowlist and images

components.name: Model access routes and accounts
components.responsibilities: Signed vendor rules, offering, org model-access narrowing, BYO user keys and org cloud accounts, account vault, routes pinned per run; people's own Claude sign-in inside Claude Code (SIGNIN: recorded login flow, per-user state, sign-in relay)

components.name: Scheduler
components.responsibilities: Cron and webhook/connector-triggered runs as the creating user, re-authorized at each firing, each slot once, catch-up (skip, run latest, run all), overlap (skip, queue, allow), the trigger context staged for the run, signed, capped and rate-limited webhooks, budgets and approvals for unattended runs, completion notices (in-app, email, Slack)

components.name: Erasure and retention (E7, E7B)
components.responsibilities: Conversation erasure across messages, citations, artifacts, workspaces, sandbox folders and journal; agent erasure; retention sweeper; crypto-shred; one-time digest-bound backfill CLI

components.name: Labs, flags and rollout
components.responsibilities: flags.json as the one flag matrix; Labs overrides with CAS; effective-flags route; kill switch; rollout decision; strict env-flag parsing; defaults in one table; the harness switch off by default (ADR-OPS-06): no harness flag, route, process or browser surface while off

components.name: Operator stops
components.responsibilities: ADR-OPS-01: the stops in force behind one extension point (OperatorStops; built in: the env kill switch alone) and their enforcement at once and on every sweeper tick within 60 s; admission refusals and engine withholding; the rollout's org stops (HarnessEdition.rolloutStops); the egress proxy's held stops (EgressStopsFeed; built in: none); the stopped reason

components.name: Shared sessions
components.responsibilities: Participants and roles, per-turn actor, per-viewer audiences, collaborator turns and next runs, continue privately (fork), session import and backup

components.name: Legacy query path (today's loop)
components.responsibilities: The query service's agent loop: planExecute, Universal Agent Mode, image, project chats, kill switch and standalone Mongo; legacy run_code; legacy flow-guard refusal

components.name: Cross-language contracts and codegen
components.responsibilities: JSON Schemas for RunSpec, events, envelopes, tool descriptors; codegen to Python and TypeScript; shared vectors (approvals, token patterns, profiles, sealing); replay corpora; event catalog

components.name: Observability and logging
components.responsibilities: OTel spans (GenAI conventions, no content by default), path-labelled metrics, structured lifecycle logs with redaction, Opik tracing behind a port

components.name: Frontend chat surfaces
components.responsibilities: Chat page, streaming and durable stream reducer, reconnect, stop, steering, approval and unknown-effect cards, engine-run card, citations, artifacts panel, project chats, regenerate

components.name: Frontend workspace and admin surfaces
components.responsibilities: Labs, approval policy and queue, unknown effects console, AI access and accounts, schedules, memories, MCP manifest approval, agent builder, skills; i18n and accessibility

components.name: Deployment, migrations and upgrade
components.responsibilities: Compose base and overlays, install.sh, Helm chart (agentHarness, sandboxBroker), D2 data migrations (dry run, apply, revert), rolling upgrade order, footprint, backup and restore

components.name: Artifacts and citations
components.responsibilities: Artifact publish intent, publish and presentation with provenance; artifact and citation access per viewer; shared artifacts and citations across participants and forks; erasure of copies

components.name: Deterministic test kit
components.responsibilities: Scripted model, ManualClock, seeded ids, failpoints, fake SaaS, fake LLM, replay kit, in-memory adapters and their own tests; every fake passes its port contract

components.name: Supply-chain trust
components.status: built (WP-85, ADR-SEC-01; shipped-image signing waits on OB-1)
components.responsibilities: One trust model for every artefact PipesHub runs or mounts: per-kind trust roots, signed attestations, verification at use (skill admission and reads, the broker's acquire) and the skill content scanner. Extension points: the trust roots (TrustRootsProvider), the skills' admission policy (SkillAdmission) and the broker's image check (ImageTrustProvider); defaults: imported skills the scanner does not flag, the release's roots and release images only

components.name: Job and Inbox view models and data layer for the classic UI
components.status: moved from the set-aside new interface (UI-ASIDE, 2026-11-10); classic screens next
components.responsibilities: UI-independent view models and client data for background jobs and the needs-you inbox: durable-run frames into trail entries and job views, job status, brief, activity and stream, the jobs list and chat dots, needs-you items, Inbox rows and words, seen marks, the jobs and Inbox API clients and stores, live Inbox counts
interfaces: lib/harness-jobs (jobView, reduceJobFrame, briefView, activityRows, jobsSections, needsYou, inboxRow, trailFromFrames)
lib/harness-jobs (JobsApi, jobStreamUrl, followJob, useSeenMarks, InboxApi, useInboxStore, useInboxLive)
lib/harness-jobs (PERSON_JOBS_KEY, refreshJobLists, useJobListsRefresh, useNeedsYouCount, openNeedsYou, useOpenChatSeenMark, sidebarDot)

components.name: Classic Jobs page, Needs you and sidebar run marks
components.responsibilities: The classic chat's background-job surfaces outside the chat: the /jobs page with its Needs you and Jobs tabs (sections, Stop, Clear finished, Load more, links into the chat at a job and an ask), the sidebar's Needs you and Jobs entries with the server's count, each chat row's one run mark, the phone menu button's dot

components.name: Background-agent kit and in-chat job card (classic look)
components.status: built (BGUI-1 kit, BGUI-2 card and board)
components.responsibilities: The design's background-agent pieces drawn with classic Radix tokens: the agent's maker logo in its tile with the status badge on its corner, the status glyph and the group label; the job card in the chat (one per job, after the turn's steps, a board past three jobs) with its status line, steps fold, Stop and the panel it opens
interfaces: JobReports, jobReportFacts (chat/components/message-area/job-card): finished jobs reporting back in finish order (BGUI-6)
JobTabs, the open job panel's Brief, Activity, Outputs and Machine tabs (chat/components/activity-panel, BGUI-3; Outputs BGUI-11)

JobReply, jobDeliverables, jobFiles, splitChangedFiles, jobClock: a job's own words through the shared answer rendering, its delivered and working files as the server classifies them, its elapsed time (BGUI-11)
citedReply, answerCitations, RunTimelineView.answer: a job reply's citation chips with their sources, from its timeline's answer citations (BGUI-12)
citedAnswer (chat/utils/cited-answer.ts): the one citation rule for the chat's answer and a job's reply, a source behind every chip (BGUI-13)
BackgroundAgentsButton, BackgroundAgentsHost (chat/components/background-agents): the chat's own agents list and its top-bar button (BGUI-5)
JobAskFloat, FloatedAskPointer, jobAsksOf, useJobAskFloat: a job's asks floating over the message box (chat/components/job-ask, BGUI-4)
ChatGrantsButton (chat/components/chat-grants): Permissions in this chat, the owner's grants with Remove, in the top bar (BGUI-7)

components.name: Inbox feed and finished-run notices
components.responsibilities: One Inbox per person (G2, ADR-INBOX-01): asks waiting on them merged with their notices, filters, read/unread/archive/restore, mutes and pause, live counts on the notification socket; finished-run notices for an interactive run that ends unwatched, on the Inbox, email and Slack where opted in; watch leases of open streams

components.name: Skill proposal review and the Inbox's typed subjects (UI-B4's kept part)
components.status: built (UI-B4); propose_agent, agent rules, skill categories, tool classes, agents usage and MCP checks set aside 2026-11-10 (UI-ASIDE)
components.responsibilities: Skill proposals approved with edits as one version, decided by their learner, change notes, display-name rename, the learning agent recorded; the Inbox's typed subjects, deleting archived notices and the push's recount hint (ADR-INBOX-01 A1-A3)
